review_candidates.title: Senior Electrical Construction Engineer
review_candidates.description_excerpt: In this role, you will be responsible for overseeing the site installation, trenching, cable pulling, jointing, termination, and testing of High Voltage (HV) and Extra High Voltage (EHV) underground cable systems. Key Responsibilities: Oversee site execution activities for UGC projects (HV/EHV cable laying, trench excavation, backfilling, duct bank installation, and joint bays). Key Qualifications: Bachelor’s Degree in Electrical Power Engineering. 5–7 years of experience in electrical construct
eligibility_evidence: Ensure strict adherence to Quality Assurance/Quality Control (QA/QC) standards and Health, Safety, and Environment (HSE) regulations on site.
Familiarity with international standards (IEC, IEEE) and local Egyptian utility regulations (EETC/EEHC).
review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: Key Qualifications: Bachelor’s Degree in Electrical Power Engineering. 5–7 years of experience in electrical construction, with a strong focus on HV/EHV Underground Cable (UGC) projects.
